text:
Little lamb of mine,

silent softness:

my breast is your grotto,

velveted with moss.


Little body, white,

a slice of moon:

I have forgotten everything

to become your cradle.


I forgot the world,

and of myself I feel

nothing but the living breast

with which I sustain you.


And all I know of myself

is that you rest in me.

Your feast, my child,

has put all feasts out.

translation.title: Little Lamb of Mine…
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
